params.prompt: Game interface mockup, full screen: the region map screen of an exploration RPG, designed as a page of an engineer's field notebook. Background: cream graph paper with a faint blue grid and small ink doodles of circuit symbols in the margins. Center-left: a hand-illustrated map with an irregular torn-edge outline, flat gouache fills and ink outlines, showing a medium-sized riverside district of a tropical port city seen from above: a hill crowned by a lighthouse, a stair neighborhood of colorful houses, a riverfront promenade with a Ferris wheel, a covered electronics market, a plaza with iguanas, a university campus beside a small lake, a patch of dry forest with a giant ceibo tree, a mangrove estuary with a boardwalk, and docks with cranes. Winding cream paths connect every zone; tiny icons mark collectible parts, wildlife and landmarks. Hand-lettered zone labels in Spanish: "MIRADOR DEL FARO", "LAS ESCALINATAS", "MALECÓN", "MERCADO", "PLAZA DE LAS IGUANAS", "CAMPUS DEL LAGO", "BOSQUE SECO", "MANGLAR", "ASTILLERO". A small red triangle marker labeled "Tú". Top left title "Cerro del Faro" beside a small lighthouse emblem. Top right filter tabs: "Todo", "Componentes", "Fauna", "Hitos". Right panel on torn paper with a compass rose and the heading "Estás aquí". Bottom legend row with small icons: "Chatarra", "Componentes", "Muestras", "Fauna", "Hitos". Palette of cream, terracotta, tropical green, petrol blue and cyan accents. Clean, legible, charming, no brand logos.
